prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 团队周报看板（第 34 周） (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 17px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "成员" · longest unbreakable word 18px · one-line width 53px
  col 2: header "状态" · longest unbreakable word 21px · one-line width 61px
  col 3: header "本周完成" · longest unbreakable word 64px · one-line width 768px
  col 4: header "下周计划" · longest unbreakable word 49px · one-line width 1057px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 437px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 436px.
Fixed: content, font, 17px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"按成员汇总第 34 周的工作状态、本周完成情况和下周计划，帮助团队识别进展、风险与阻塞。","reading":"读者先按行找到成员和状态，再横向阅读完成情况与计划；也会纵向扫描状态，比较不同成员的进展。长文本将决定行高，较短单元格可在同一行内留白。","groups":["「成员」与「状态」共同构成每行的身份和状态索引，应便于快速扫描。","「本周完成」与「下周计划」分别描述过去与未来的工作，角色相近，需要保留足够空间供连续阅读和比较。"],"keep_intact":["成员姓名","状态图标与文字","数字、英文缩写及其他不可断开的标识"],"may_wrap":["本周完成的中文叙述可自然换行。","下周计划的中文叙述可自然换行；较短的完成情况可利用计划产生的行高。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [74, 82, 140, 140] · table 437×1567px · row heights [39, 276, 276, 303, 197, 250, 224] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 11 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [74, 82, 175, 105] · table 437×2200px · row heights [39, 408, 408, 435, 250, 356, 303] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 16 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [74, 82, 105, 175] · table 437×1752px · row heights [39, 276, 329, 276, 303, 250, 276] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 12 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"成员姓名和状态图标、文字均保持完整，便于纵向扫描；两列叙述宽度相同，表头清晰，横向阅读关系直接。","problems":"下周计划普遍比本周完成更长，多数行由计划撑高，完成列下方留出较大空白；计划列也因频繁换行而显得局促。","cause":"两列均为 140px，但计划内容总长度更大；成员和状态列的 74px、82px 已基本贴合单行内容。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"本周完成列较宽，叙述比较连贯；成员和状态仍可快速识别，表头完整。","problems":"下周计划被挤成很窄的文字带，阅读频繁折行，行高大幅增加；完成列下方出现大片空白，削弱同一行的关联。","cause":"175px 分给本周完成，而更长的下周计划只有 105px，正文可用宽度仅 84px。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"下周计划有较宽的阅读空间，长句比 r0A 和 r0B 更连贯；成员、状态和表头保持完整。","problems":"本周完成列过窄，多个成员的完成情况被切成短行，并反过来撑高行，计划列下方出现明显空白；两列视觉权重也过于失衡。","cause":"本周完成只有 105px，下周计划为 175px；计划获得的额外空间以牺牲完成列的连续阅读为代价。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced-plan","widths":[74,82,130,150],"change":"在 r0A 基础上从完成列移 10px 给内容更长的计划列，尝试减少计划主导的行高，同时保留完成列的可读宽度。"},{"name":"plan-leaning","widths":[74,82,120,160],"change":"测试更明显但仍温和的计划倾斜，寻找 r0A 与 r0C 之间两列换行和行高的平衡。"},{"name":"near-even","widths":[74,82,135,145],"change":"只给计划列少量额外宽度，检验能否保留接近对等的列节奏，同时缓解 r0A 中计划列的拥挤。"}]}
